candidates.excerpt: The Delhi High Court on Thursday recorded the assurance given by the Delhi Police that all possible measures under the law would be taken to control the proposed protest by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) and its founder Abhijeet Dipke at Connaught Place on Friday.

candidates.title: Supreme Court Issues Notices to Centre, Election Commission Over Alleged Voter List Irregularities
candidates.excerpt: The Supreme Court has issued notices to the Central Government and the Election Commission of India on a petition alleging large-scale deletions of voters’ names and irregularities in electoral rolls.

candidates.title: Telangana power crisis: Harish Rao accuses Revanth of blaming officials
candidates.excerpt: BRS deputy floor leader T Harish Rao criticised the Congress government over Telangana’s power crisis, accusing Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy of blaming officials instead of ensuring adequate coal stocks, reviewing the power sector and preparing for El Niño conditions
